top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a clean theory-plus-decisive-experiment chain: spin-orbit coupling and time-reversal symmetry give a Z2 invariant and protected helical edge states without a magnetic field, predicted by Kane and Mele and first seen in HgTe wells by Molenkamp, then reproduced widely over two decades. The narrow citation keeps all three names defensible, though the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and 3D-strand omissions remain a real credit cost. I rank the lattice clocks (P003) next as a robust, reproduced and genuinely new measurement capability, and twisted bilayer graphene (P002) third because it is only eight years old with the pairing mechanism unsettled; any award is preferred to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no direct link to Kane, Mele, Molenkamp, Katori, Ye, MacDonald or Jarillo-Herrero, though I am not a condensed-matter specialist
